correctness.rationale: The zero-free bound follows from Bieberbach plus the area theorem and an exact Cauchy-Schwarz tail series; a separate area-theorem estimate gives |U_F|<1. The lower obstruction uses a starlike power family whose positive U-series diverges for every sigma<1.

originality.rationale: The 2013 source gives the explicit universal bound 3/2 and poses the threshold problem. Searches of exact, synonymous and polylogarithmic-convolution formulations did not locate the 1.413520 upper bound, the series-root criterion, or the universal lower obstruction 1. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with incomplete theorem-level access to the 1996 polylogarithm paper recorded as the main residual risk.

value.rationale: The result narrows a concrete published threshold problem from the one-sided bound sigma_U<=3/2 to 1<=sigma_U<1.413520 and isolates distinct upper- and lower-bound mechanisms.

limitations: The exact universal U-threshold remains unresolved between 1 and 1.413520.
The lower example excludes U-membership but does not establish non-univalence.
The upper argument may be improved by sharper coupled reciprocal-coefficient information.
